facts.fact: 她发短信：那晚太激烈，需要时间理清
facts.anchor: KT: The other night was intense, and I need some time to sift through my thoughts.

facts.fact: 三方断联：Logan/Boone/Levi 都不理他
facts.anchor: Logan wasn’t talking to me. Boone wasn’t talking to me.

facts.fact: 他放弃睡床改睡沙发：她无处不在
facts.anchor: I’d given up on sleeping in the bed, opting to stay on the couch instead. It didn’t matter—she was everywhere.

facts.fact: 他最怕的一句：万一失去她
facts.anchor: What if I lose her?

facts.fact: Georgia来替Logan取东西（耳机和书）
facts.anchor: She ducked her head, a guilty expression on her face. “Logan asked me to pick up a few things.”

facts.fact: Georgia的宽解：比错误更重要的是补救的步骤
facts.anchor: What matters more than the mistake is the steps we take to remedy it.

facts.fact: Georgia天使计画：先给他收拾仪容再收拾心情
facts.anchor: I think we should start by cleaning you up

facts.fact: 她说人人该有第二次机会——又低声改口“也未必人人”
facts.anchor: “Everyone deserves a second chance.” She patted my shoulder and straightened. “Well, maybe not everyone,”

facts.fact: 一周静默：她只要了空间，两人都没联系
facts.anchor: I hadn’t texted him since before I’d left for Minnesota, asking for space. A week of silence.

facts.fact: Levi的话在她脑内循环
facts.anchor: Anyone but him.

facts.fact: 她卡在忠诚与真心之间
facts.anchor: I was torn between my loyalty to my brother and my heart.

facts.fact: 她向母亲承认：怕哥哥再也不理她
facts.anchor: “I’m scared Levi will never speak to me again.”

facts.fact: 妈妈反问：该问的不是我能否原谅他
facts.anchor: “I’m not sure I’m the one he needs forgiveness from.

facts.fact: 妈妈的锋利问题：即使Levi永不原谅，你还能和他在一起吗
facts.anchor: do you think you can be with Carson, even if Levi never forgives him?

facts.fact: 她最大的自我审判
facts.anchor: “Am I a terrible person for loving someone who hurt my brother so deeply?”

facts.fact: 妈妈看人标准：断联的勇气+后续努力比过去更能说明品性
facts.anchor: It must have taken a lot of strength for him to cut ties with them.

facts.fact: 妈妈把决定权还给她：你的心怎么说
facts.anchor: “What does your heart tell you?”

facts.fact: 冲浪课返场：她先沉下去再上浮
facts.anchor: But I tried to sink down, as Coach had said, so I could rise back up.

facts.fact: 妈妈的结论：两件事可以同时为真
facts.anchor: “Two things can be true at once. You can be in love with Carson but also not want to hurt Levi.”

facts.fact: 妈妈的最后一句：爱他是否值得冒险，得由你判
facts.anchor: you may have to decide whether loving Carson is worth the risk.
